_about: T035 labelled eval set. 20 requirement/resume pairs against Best_withoutphoto.pdf, hand-labelled. `paraphrase` restates the requirement without the resume's vocabulary, for the R1 anti-keyword-match test (T037). `rationale` records why the label was chosen so a disagreement is visible rather than silent. One label (Unit testing) was corrected after the first eval run exposed it.
